TextView.android:text: For first-year diploma students in Maharashtra, the MSBTE Scholarship (specifically the MSBTE Scholarship for Meritorious Students) is a prestigious financial aid program aimed at supporting students who have excelled in their 10th-grade (SSC) exams. Here is the essential information you need for the 2025–26 academic year: 1. Eligibility Criteria To qualify for the MSBTE scholarship in your first year, you must meet these conditions: Academic: You must have secured at least 70% marks (or equivalent grade) in your SSC (10th) examination. Admission: You must be a regular student admitted to an AICTE-approved diploma course in a government, aided, or unaided polytechnic affiliated with MSBTE. Income: Your annual family income should not exceed ₹8 Lakh. Exclusivity: You should not be receiving any other government scholarship (like MahaDBT, EBC, or Minority scholarships) at the same time.

• Academic: Minimum 70% in 10th (SSC).
• Admission: Regular student in AICTE-approved diploma.
• Income: Family income below ₹8 Lakh.
• Exclusivity: No other govt. scholarships (MahaDBT etc.)
2. Scholarship Amount The scholarship typically provides ₹7,000 per year. This amount is intended to cover tuition fees and other educational expenses.
The scholarship provides ₹7,000 per year for tuition fees and educational expenses.

3. Application Process The application is usually handled through the official MSBTE portal rather than the standard MahaDBT site. Online Registration: Visit the official MSBTE website. Form Submission: Fill out the scholarship application form during the window (usually announced in the first semester). Institute Verification: Submit a hard copy of the application and required documents to your college's scholarship desk for verification.
• Visit MSBTE official website.\n• Fill form during the 1st semester window.\n• Submit hard copy at college desk for verification.
